idea.title: A polished carousel needs export-time font verification
idea.summary: A visual review found that headings used the intended Arabic family while inherited body copy used a different fallback. The correction applied the slide type system at the shared canvas and waited for the selected font faces before Playwright capture.

context.goal: Correct the seven personal carousel layouts without changing their content model or workflow.
context.situation: The exported 1080 square slides had inconsistent Arabic typography, corner marks, oversized hierarchy, and an unrelated evidence image.
context.problem: The slide-level font variable did not become an inherited font rule, and the exporter could capture before the intended font faces were ready.
context.investigation: Rendered PNG inspection traced the serif text to body inheritance and the edge marks to shared slide pseudo-elements.
context.decision: Set the approved Arabic family on the shared slide canvas, wait for that family and the technical mono face in export, and use a labelled conceptual diagram when no factual image supports the fixture.
context.implementation: Adjusted shared slide typography and spacing, removed export-visible corner marks, rebalanced the sequence, comparison, and closing layouts, and added a local project-structure conceptual diagram fixture.
context.result: Seven 1080 square exports passed layout, overflow, footer, evidence-loading, Studio/export equivalence, adapter/validation, build, and font-wait checks.

learning_points: A CSS custom property does not change inherited typography until a component applies it as a font-family rule.
Visual export checks need to wait for the exact font faces used by the design.
A labelled conceptual diagram is more honest than unrelated imagery when no real evidence is available.
story_points: The mismatch was visible only after looking at the exported slides, not the type declarations alone.
The footer problem was caused by layout growth, so the correction removed the unnecessary flex expansion rather than adding another footer implementation.
The same SlideRenderer markup was compared across Studio preview, Studio export, and the export route.
possible_angles: Why a correct font declaration can still produce mismatched exported text.
What to check before trusting a generated carousel PNG.
How to show a conceptual technical diagram without presenting it as proof.

notes: No canonical post copy was changed.
